xmldoc.short_description: Figure that contains the object whose callback is running.

param_output_item.param_description: a graphics object: a figure, or [] when no callback is running.

description.p: fig = gcbf() returns the figure that holds the object whose callback is being executed. It is the same as the second output of gcbo.
When the object of the callback is itself a figure, that figure is returned. When it is not inside a figure, the current figure is returned (a figure is created if none exists).
Outside a callback, or when the object of the callback no longer exists, gcbf returns an empty matrix ([]).
Unlike gcf, the result does not depend on which figure is current: a callback can safely find its own figure even if another figure was made current meanwhile.

example_item.example_item_description: The callback reads the name of its figure.
A button that closes its own figure (click the button).
